newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baloise sells units to Carige.
newsitem.headline: Baloise sells units to Carige.

text.p: Swiss insurance group Baloise Holding AG said it will sell two of its units in northern Italy to Banca Carige, and said that it would take a four to five percent stake in Carige.
It also said that Carige planned to increase its capital by up to 500 billion lire.
Baloise said that it would not exercise any "operative functions" at Carige despite the equity stake.
Baloise said the latest sales followed similar moves in recent years, in which it already divested other holdings in France, Spain and Italy.

It said the latest sales involved two subsidiaries, Norditalia, including its subsidiary Basilese Vita Nuova, and Levante. Carige already held 20 percent of Levante and Basilese Vita Nova, Baloise said.
Baloise will retain a minority 10 percent stake in the units. A spokeswoman for the Swiss insurer said that no price was published in the transaction.
The deal requires approval of Italian banking and insurance authorities, Baloise said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
